responsibility: This machine-description fragment contains the automaton scheduler model for the Marvell/Cavium ThunderX3 CN11xx microarchitecture under the "thunderx3t110" tuning name. It defines a wider set of integer and FP/AdvSIMD resources than ThunderX2, along with load/store-delay and multiply pseudo-units, and assigns reservations and latencies for scalar ALU, branch, divide, multiply-accumulate, scalar FP, AdvSIMD, structured vector memory operations, and crypto/CRC/PMULL instructions so that GCC can schedule for ThunderX3’s distinct pipeline structure and throughput.
